canonical_form: Let Γ=Z_A⊗Z_B, Π±=(I±Γ)/2, Ψ†Ψ=I2, U=Π+Ψ, V=Π−Ψ. Since U†U+V†V=I2, one right 2×2 unitary simultaneously diagonalizes them: U†U=diag(p1,p2), V†V=diag(1−p1,1−p2). After completing zero-norm columns arbitrarily, Ψ_i=√p_i u_i+√(1−p_i)v_i with p_i∈[0,1], {u_i} orthonormal in H+≅C8, {v_i} orthonormal in H−≅C8. This is every rank-two projector, including endpoints, up to a right basis change.
exact_coupling_geometry: Podd=(P−ΓPΓ)/2=Σ_i√(p_i(1−p_i))(|u_i⟩⟨v_i|+|v_i⟩⟨u_i|). Its operator norm is max_i√(p_i(1−p_i))≤1/2 and Frobenius norm² is 2Σ_i p_i(1−p_i)≤1. Since Xd commutes and Xn anticommutes with Γ, D(P),N(P) depend only on Peven, whereas J(P) depends only on Podd. In particular J=0 at all parity-invariant P, while SAME-parity opposite-sector coherences need not vanish.

This follows because each independent normalized combination spans one orthonormal rank-two test isometry; conversely the canonical form represents every isometry. No minimization or rank2 input is omitted.
